subject: crtf-d
title: CRTF.D.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in WI-8. (C)CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions) is crossed with MT-INFO (multi-information). The (c) on cross-transfer-definitions is critical: this is the *concept* of cross-transfer definitions — the institutional mechanism by which a piece of source-initiated music gets re-defined when it transfers across cultural lines. The diagram poses what multi-information looks like when crossed with that conceptual mechanism. CRTF-D → MT-INFO (the crossing) and CRTF-D → (R)INT (the reality of intention). (R)INT branches to ALT-D (alternative definitions) and EXT-DYM (extended dynamics). EXT-DYM branches to APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions), which forks into AFN (affinity negation) and AFTF (affinity transfer), and to ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism).
